question: Why are WeakMaps NOT iterable and have no `.size` property?
options: The ES6 committee ran out of time
Garbage collection is non-deterministic, so the number of entries could change at any moment
WeakMaps are stored in browser cookies
WeakMaps only store a single element
explanation: Because keys are weakly held and subject to garbage collection at any time, providing iteration or size would expose non-deterministic GC behavior.
